notes: Static, single-entry-point editorial site for the fictional monthly publication FOLD. Hero with a hand-drawn folded-sheet animation, a story list using details accordions with scroll-reveal, an About section with a hand-drawn typewriter illustration, and a Contact section with a mailto address and CTA. All imagery is hand-drawn SVG (hero sheets, per-story glyphs, typewriter); colours are strictly greyscale; favicon is assets/favicon.svg. A small inline script adds scroll reveal with prefers-reduced-motion support. Works from file:// and GitHub Pages via relative paths.
